Library

The documents written while the platform was designed, each with its date and what has since replaced any part of it.

These documents hold detail the section pages summarise. They are kept at their original addresses so that links shared earlier still work. Where one uses older framing (the "rails" or "pathways" in place of the four branches), the table says so.
